title: Identity
text: Muhammad Zahiruddin is a software developer known online as Zahir or zahir248. He builds and maintains production web systems and apps end to end: requirements, implementation, deployment, and support. He has eight live projects: his own civic map mySekilas, his own organiser app Uros on Google Play, an AI analysis platform (NUJUM), conference ticketing (BINA), a freelance website for ENADD Logistics in Singapore, a fan community and shop (MyGooners, web side), and company and school websites (EST Group, SMK Seremban 3). He takes freelance work. Portfolio: https://zahir248.github.io/portfolio/

title: What Zahir does, in plain words
text: In plain words, Zahir builds the websites and mobile apps that businesses use every day, such as the page where people buy a conference ticket, an online shop, an Android app on Google Play, or the login staff use to update their company website. His work has three parts: he finds out what the business needs, he builds the website, app or system (the pages people see and the parts behind the scenes that store information, take payments and send emails), and he puts it online and keeps it running, fixing problems and training staff. When a visitor does not seem technical, explain things in this simple way and avoid jargon.

title: Core skills (production)
text: Zahir's core skills, used in production work: PHP, Laravel, MySQL, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, React, Flutter, Java, Spring Boot, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, Linux (Ubuntu), cPanel, Git, GitHub Actions. Most of his client work is Laravel, PHP and MySQL. He built and published his own Flutter app, Uros, on Google Play, with a React web version and a Spring Boot backend. On MyGooners he built the web side and a teammate built that project's Flutter app.

title: Familiar skills (side projects and learning)
text: Skills Zahir is familiar with from side projects, testing or learning (not his main production stack): Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Docker, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS). Be honest that these are familiar rather than core if asked.

text: Zahir has worked full-time as a Software Developer at Intensiti Elemen SDN BHD since May 2025, plus a 6-month web developer internship at VX Ventures SDN BHD (Oct 2024 – Mar 2025). When asked about years of experience, give full-time and internship separately.

text: Integrations Zahir has worked with: ToyyibPay, Stripe, AI APIs (Google Gemini, OpenAI), Google OAuth, Google reCAPTCHA, SMTP email, OneSignal, Telegram Bot API. Tools: GitHub, GitLab, Postman, Figma, VS Code, Android Studio. Languages spoken: Malay and English.

title: Project: Uros (Google Play app)
text: Uros is Zahir's own app, built solo: a private personal organiser for finance, notes and a diary, published on Google Play (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.uros.zahir) with a web version at https://uros-mu.vercel.app/. The Android app is built with Flutter and the web version with React and Vite (hosted on Vercel); both run on a Spring Boot (Java) backend hosted on Render. Features: expenses by category, monthly budgets, spending charts and PDF reports; notes that can be pinned, searched and locked with a private PIN; a daily diary with a calendar view; sign-in with Google or email, optional two-factor authentication, session management with remote sign-out, and account deletion; optional Telegram alerts for spending; light and dark themes; English and Malay.

title: Project: NUJUM
text: NUJUM is a web-based AI analysis platform (no mobile app). Live at https://iesb.com.my/nujum/. Stack: Laravel, MySQL, Google Gemini API, OpenAI API, ToyyibPay. Role: Full-stack, solo. Built at Intensiti Elemen, Zahir's employer (an in-house product, not a client project). Timeline: Aug 2025 – Jul 2026. Users pick one of six kinds of analysis (prediction, trend topic, social profile, profile comparison, communication pack, fact check), answer a few questions, and get a report that names its sources, in Malay or English. It also has a document library with an Ask feature that answers from the user's own files with sources, a war room, a daily brief, stakeholder tracking, PDF export and shareable links, a free tier of 3 analyses, and monthly paid plans with usage allowances and team accounts.

title: Project: MyGooners
text: MyGooners is a Malay-language Arsenal fan community and shop. Live at https://mygooners.my/. Zahir built the web side (Laravel, MySQL, ToyyibPay, Stripe) in a team of two; his teammate built the Flutter Android app. Built at Intensiti Elemen, Zahir's employer (not a client). Timeline: Jul 2025 – Jun 2026. Web features Zahir built: football news and video publishing, a directory of verified service providers, and a shop with checkout and order records, all run from one admin panel.

title: Project: BINA E-Ticketing
text: BINA e-ticketing is the event site and ticketing system for BINA, an ASEAN construction conference at MITEC Kuala Lumpur held during International Construction Week. Live at https://iesb.com.my/Bina2026/. Stack: Laravel, MySQL, ToyyibPay, Stripe. Role: Full-stack, solo. Client: CIDB IBS. Timeline: built May – Oct 2025 for BINA 2025, then updated by Zahir for the BINA 2026 edition. Features: event pages for each programme (such as Facility Management Engagement Day and Modular Asia), online registration and ticket purchase, digital tickets and purchase history, and admin tools for orders and ticket records.

title: Project: EST Group
text: EST Group is a company website for a solar installation (EPCC) and NexTron EV charging company. Live at https://estgroup.com.my/. Stack: Laravel, MySQL. Role: Full-stack, solo. Client: EST Group. Timeline: Feb 2026 – Jun 2026. Pages: Home, About, What We Do, Partner We Seek, Contact. Staff update partners, team and contact details through a staff login, and the contact form sends messages to the company email.

title: Project: SMK Seremban 3
text: SMK Seremban 3 is the official Malay-language portal of a secondary school in Seremban. Live at https://iesb.com.my/smks3/. Stack: PHP, MySQL. Role: Full-stack, team of two. Client: SMK Seremban 3. Timeline: Mar 2026 – Jul 2026. Sections: school profile, management, curriculum, student affairs, co-curriculum, PIBG, school media and monthly bulletins. Staff update news, schedules and school info through a staff portal, and each unit edits only its own pages.

title: All projects (overview)
text: Zahir has eight live projects. His own products: mySekilas (interactive map of Malaysia's elected representatives and state news, Laravel and Gemini) and Uros (personal organiser on Google Play, Flutter app, React web version, Spring Boot backend). Built at his employer Intensiti Elemen: NUJUM (AI report writer for PR and communications teams, Laravel with Gemini and OpenAI) and MyGooners (Arsenal fan community and shop; he built the web side). Client work: BINA e-ticketing for CIDB IBS (conference ticketing, used again for 2026), EST Group (solar and EV charger company website) and SMK Seremban 3 (school website). Freelance: ENADD Logistics, a company website for a Singapore logistics firm. When asked what he has built, mention all eight briefly.

title: Project: mySekilas
text: mySekilas is Zahir's own personal project, built solo (design, build, data and deploy). Live at https://mysekilas.onrender.com/. Stack: Laravel, Vite, Google Gemini API, hosted on Render. It is an interactive map of Malaysia in Malay and English that shows each state's government, members of parliament and state assemblymen, and current issues. Features: search by area, postcode or name; a 'Who is my YB?' button that matches the user's location inside the browser without sending it to the server; Dewan Rakyat seat counts checked against official portals; live headlines from many Malaysian news portals, grouped when several cover the same story and tagged by state and topic; story summaries and a daily round-up written with Google Gemini; a guide to who to contact for a problem; a political history section.

title: Project: ENADD Logistics (freelance)
text: ENADD Logistics is a freelance project: a company website for ENADD Logistics (S) Pte Ltd, a Singapore freight forwarding and marine logistics company. Live at https://enadd.com.sg/. Zahir designed, built and deployed it solo. Stack: HTML, Bootstrap 5, JavaScript. Pages: Home, About, Services, Contact. Features: a service catalogue (air and sea freight, Malaysia to Singapore trucking, FTZ warehousing, marine logistics), a Get a quote button on every page leading to an enquiry form that opens the visitor's email app, direct lines for operations, finance and sales, an office map, and a link to the company's Gurusoft operations portal.

title: Project: this portfolio and its AI chatbot
text: Zahir's portfolio site is itself one of his projects, and its code is public at https://github.com/zahir248/portfolio. The site is hosted on GitHub Pages in English and Malay. The 'Ask my AI' chatbot is a Node.js serverless function on Vercel: it turns the visitor's question into a Google Gemini embedding, finds the most relevant parts of the portfolio content by similarity, and has Gemini write the answer in the visitor's language, with a per-visitor rate limit. A GitHub Actions job written in Node.js refreshes the screenshot of every project each day. Most of Zahir's client work is in Laravel because that is what those teams use, but he works across stacks: plain PHP (SMK Seremban 3), HTML, Bootstrap and JavaScript (ENADD Logistics), and Node.js (this chatbot and the screenshot job).
